Letter from our team

May 2024

Running a restaurant is tough enough already. But it shouldn’t be this tough. With Atlas, we are here to help you focus on things that matter.

The business model for restaurants is fundamentally changing because everything is going online. People will transact more with their devices. Restaurants will need to find different ways to reach customers and optimise their operations (deliveries, pickup, pre-orders, social ordering, virtual brands, cloud kitchens, food aggregators, etc.).

There will be a need for unified and seamless online and offline food commerce experiences. Atlas believes that merging the omnichannel worlds into a single source of truth (customer, orders, menus, products, etc.) can 10X the consumer experience.

Atlas will develop these tools to support these business models of the future of restaurants — for you and for our friends in the industry (PS: We are also the folks behind the online restaurant, Grain!).

Atlas is our love letter to restaurants, and we’re just getting started.
